title: Crews
intro: Athletes join local crews, find groups by pace and place, and battle other crews on shared division tables. Training together keeps people training.
points: Find a crew nearby, matched to your pace
Weekly crew battles on a division table
Everyone's effort counts towards the crew total
privacy: Quiet weeks never count as zero. Nobody lets their crew down by resting.

title: Challenges
intro: Branded distance and streak challenges with live progress, leaderboards and a clear finish line. Your brand is there for the whole journey, not just the checkout.
points: Distance and streak challenges in your brand
Finishing is a moment worth recognising
privacy: Athletes choose which challenges to join. Nothing is entered on their behalf.

screens.name: 100K November
screens.alt: The 100K November challenge, showing the athlete's progress towards 100 kilometres.

screens.name: Summit Reached
screens.alt: A challenge completion screen celebrating the athlete reaching the summit.

title: Routes & markers
intro: Routes and markers turn local places into things worth reaching. Completing an epic route or claiming a gold marker is a moment the engine can respond to straight away.
points: Curated local routes, from river loops to summits
Gold markers to find and claim along the way
Every completed route feeds the athlete's momentum
privacy: One location read per tap. We check where an athlete is only when they ask us to.
